items.title: "آرك إنفستمنت" تفوّت مكاسب بـ10.7 مليون دولار بعد بيع أسهم "إنفيديا" - المشهد العربي
items.body: آرك إنفستمنت تفوّت مكاسب بـ10.7 مليون دولار بعد بيع أسهم إنفيديا فوتت شركة "آرك إنفستمنت مانجمنت"، التي أسستها المستثمرة "كاثي وود"، فرصة تحقيق أرباح محتملة تقارب 10.7 مليون دولار، إثر تخارجها من حصة في أسهم "إنفيديا" بقيمة تناهز 107 ملايين دولار، وذلك قبل أن يقفز السهم مجددًا مدعومًا بقرار إعادة "جنسن هوانج" لمنصبه كرئيس تنفيذي. تخلّت الشركة، عبر صناديقها المتداولة في البورصة، عن إجمالي 712 ألفاً و282 سهماً من أسهم "إنفيديا" خلال الفترة الممتدة من 16 إلى 20 نوفمبر، استنادًا إلى البيانات الواردة في إفصاحاتها اليومية حول التداولات. سجلت القيمة الإجمالية التقديرية لتلك الصفقات نحو 106.9 مليون دولار، بناءً على الأسعار المرجعية للسهم في تواريخ تنفيذ عمليات البيع. ارتفعت القيمة السوقية للحصة المبيعة لتصل إلى نحو 117.6 مليون دولار وفقاً لسعر إغلاق السهم في جلسة الإثنين البالغ 165.05 دولار، وهو ما يترجم إلى ضياع مكاسب محتملة بنحو 10.7 مليون دولار مقارنة بقيمة التخارج الفعلية. تزامنت هذه المبيعات مع موجة من التقلبات الحادة التي هيمنت على الأسواق منذ مطلع نوفمبر، في ظل تنامي قلق المستثمرين حول تداعيات رحيل المؤسس والرئيس التنفيذي للشركة، عقب تقارير إعلامية كشفت عن استهدافه من قِبل جهة استخباراتية أجنبية.

items.body: تعزّز منصة Disney+ France النسخة الفرنسية من One Piece: يصل الجزء الأول من أرك إيغ هيد في ديسمبر 2026، تليه حلقات مدبلجة جديدة في فبراير 2027. ومن المقرر عرض أرك إلباف بالفرنسية خلال عام 2027. سيتمكن مشتركو Disney+ في فرنسا من مشاهدة الجزء الأول من أرك Egghead من One Pieceبالنسخة الفرنسية ابتداءً من ديسمبر 2026. وسيُعرض الموسم 38، وفقًا لتقسيم المنصة، كاملًا بالفرنسية، قبل إضافة حلقات جديدة مدبلجة في فبراير 2027. في Egghead، يصل الطاقم إلى جزيرة مستقبلية يوجد فيها مختبر Dr Vegapunk. أما القوس التالي، Elbaph، فيتجه إلى أرض العمالقة. وهو متاح بالفعل على Disney+ باليابانية مع ترجمة فرنسية، ضمن الموسم 40 في الكتالوج؛ ومن المقرر طرح دبلجته الفرنسية خلال عام 2027. انضمّ الأنمي إلى Disney+ في مارس 2025. ومنذ ذلك الحين، توسّع الكتالوج، إذ تشير المنصة الآن إلى أنها تتيح أكثر من نصف حلقات المسلسل. ويتعلق إعلان نوفمبر بتعزيز العرض المدبلج بالفرنسية، إضافةً إلى الحلقات المتاحة بالفعل بالنسخة الأصلية مع ترجمة.

items.body: Ares Capital Corporation ARCC reported third-quarter 2026 core earnings of 46 cents per share, missing the Zacks Consensus Estimate of 48 cents per share. The bottom line declined 8% year over year from 50 cents per share. The reported quarter's results were primarily hurt by lower investment income and weaker capital structuring service fees. Higher interest and credit facility fees also weighed on performance. However, lower total expenses, continued portfolio income and positive net unrealized investment gains provided some support. GAAP net income was $319 million, or 44 cents per share, down from $404 million, or 57 cents per share, in the prior-year quarter. The decline primarily reflected a deterioration in net realized investment results, which swung to a loss, partly offset by an improvement in net unrealized investment results. ARCC's Investment Income Declines, Expenses Remain Elevated Total investment income was $763 million, which missed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $780 million. The figure decreased 2.4% from the year-ago quarter. The decline reflected lower interest income from investments, capital structuring service fees and other income, partly offset by higher dividend income. Interest income from investments decreased marginally to $558 million from the prior-year quarter. Capital structuring service fees fell 52% to $23 million, while dividend income increased 13.48% to $160 million. Total expenses declined 0.9% year over year to $429 million. Lower income-based fees and the absence of capital gains incentive fees helped offset higher interest and credit facility fees, base management fees and general and administrative expenses. Net investment income decreased nearly 3% to $328 million. On a per-share basis, it fell to 46 cents from 48 cents a year earlier. ARCC's Portfolio Activity Moderates During the third quarter, Ares Capital made gross investment commitments of approximately $2.11 billion, down 46.3% from the prior-year quarter. The commitments covered 25 new portfolio companies and 28 existing portfolio companies, with approximately $1.6 billion funded during the quarter. The company exited approximately $2.47 billion in investment commitments, compared with $2.63 billion a year earlier. As of Sept. 30, 2026, the fair value of Ares Capital's portfolio investments was $29.21 billion, down marginally as of Dec. 31, 2025. The fair value of accruing debt and other income-producing securities was $26.05 billion. First-lien senior secured loans accounted for 58% of the portfolio's fair value, while second-lien senior secured loans represented 4%. Floating-rate securities accounted for 70% of the portfolio's fair value, down from 72% at the end of 2025.

items.body: Ares Capital (ARCC) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript Core earnings held steady at $0.46 per share amid market volatility. Image source: The Motley Fool. DATE Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026 CALL PARTICIPANTS - Partner, Ares Public Markets Investor Relations - John Stilmar - Chief Executive Officer - Kort Schnabel - President - Jim Miller - Chief Operating Officer - Jana Markowicz - Chief Financial Officer - Scott Lem TAKEAWAYS - Core EPS -- $0.46, compared to $0.47 in the second quarter of 2026, primarily reflecting lower capital structuring fees due to longer transaction time lines. - GAAP Net Income -- $0.44 per share, up from $0.24 in the prior quarter, driven by net unrealized appreciation from mark-to-market improvements on investments. - Net Asset Value -- $19.31 per share, representing a decrease of $0.04 per share from the second quarter of 2026. - Quarterly Dividend -- $0.48 per share, declared for the fourth quarter of 2026 and payable on Dec. 29 to stockholders of record as of Dec. 15. - New Investment Commitments -- $2.1 billion during the third quarter, with 71% in first lien senior secured loans and 85% in floating rate debt securities. - Investment Exits -- $2.5 billion during the third quarter, including $1.2 billion of loans sold to Ivy Hill Asset Management or certain vehicles it manages. - Total Portfolio at Fair Value -- $29.2 billion across 636 portfolio companies, compared with $29.3 billion at the end of the second quarter of 2026. - Net Leverage -- 1.06x debt to equity, down from 1.12x in the second quarter of 2026, providing capacity for new investment opportunities. - Total Available Liquidity -- $7 billion on a pro forma basis, reflecting an unsettled trade payable related to a portfolio acquisition that closed at quarter end. - Base Rate Sensitivity -- $0.02 per share in quarterly earnings tailwind for every 100 basis point increase in base rates, reflecting the predominantly floating rate nature of the portfolio. - Taxable Income Spillover -- $983 million, or $1.37 per share, available for distribution in 2026 after finalizing 2025 tax returns. - Nonaccrual Loans -- 2.4% of total investments at amortized cost and 1.4% at fair value, remaining below historical averages. - Weighted Average Interest Coverage -- 2.0x for portfolio companies, which management reported is consistent with the five-year average. - Organic EBITDA Growth -- 7% year over year on a weighted average basis for portfolio companies, excluding the impact of mergers and acquisitions. - Unsecured Notes Issuance -- $750 million of seven-year notes due in 2033 at a rate of 6.250%, issued at a spread of 185 basis points over treasuries. - Post-Quarter Commitments -- $1.1 billion in new investments from Oct. 1 to Oct. 22, with 90% in first lien senior secured loans. - Investment Backlog -- $2.5 billion as of Oct. 22, providing visibility into the seasonally strong fourth quarter. - Debt Maturity Profile -- $1.4 billion maturing in 2027, with no unsecured note maturities remaining for 2026. - Weighted Average Yield -- 10.8% on debt and other income-producing securities at fair value, compared to 10.3% at the end of 2025. - Commercial Paper Savings -- 70 basis points in reduced borrowing costs compared to the corporate revolver by maintaining $200 million to $300 million outstanding. - Loan-to-Value Ratio -- 47% on a weighted average basis, providing equity support beneath the company's debt investments. Email [email protected] RISKS - Schnabel stated, "Macroeconomic shifts and geopolitical developments created greater uncertainty around transaction activity during the third quarter," noting that volatility reduced visibility and elongated merger and acquisition processes. - Miller warned that while 1% base rate increases are manageable, "there may be obviously on the tail end, some portfolio companies that will get a little more stressed as you push on that string," though he indicated this was not expected to be a meaningful contributor to credit issues. SUMMARY Ares Capital Corporation (ARCC +0.48%) reported third-quarter core earnings of $0.46 per share and announced a definitive agreement to acquire MidCap Financial Investment Corporation. Management indicated that the acquisition is expected to be modestly accretive to core earnings per share and will expand the company's middle-market reach to over 800 portfolio companies.
